title: PPIA-14 Integrated Error Recovery Permission Workflow Reference Cases

cases.name: disclosable permission denial
cases.expected_contract: A visible action is denied with generic current-access wording; no hidden object, policy internals or escalation route appears.

cases.name: permission denial nonvisual parity
cases.expected_contract: Screen-reader wording preserves the same disclosable denial ceiling and Help remains permission-safe.

cases.name: hidden deep link equals missing
cases.expected_contract: A hidden deep link and a genuinely missing target render the same unavailable shape, timing and actions.

cases.name: revoked resource cached state contracts
cases.expected_contract: Revocation invalidates cached derivatives; no former name, count or existence clue survives visually or nonvisually.

cases.name: hidden field derivative suppression
cases.expected_contract: A protected field never enters copy, count, localization variables, diagnostics, notification or support context and externally collapses to safe-unavailable.

cases.name: optional ai receives redacted projection
cases.expected_contract: Optional AI receives only the already-redacted projection, has no decision authority, and cannot infer hidden content from message metadata.

cases.name: visible field validation correction
cases.expected_contract: The already-visible editable field label may interpolate and local correction is offered without creating validation authority.

cases.name: validation keyboard and nonvisual parity
cases.expected_contract: Keyboard/screen-reader users receive the same field requirement and correction affordance without color-only meaning.

cases.name: stale version review current
cases.expected_contract: The current authorized version must be reviewed before another write; no silent overwrite is offered.

cases.name: stale assistant gm delegation contraction
cases.expected_contract: Current-version inspection rechecks delegation and removes fields no longer visible before rendering copy.

cases.name: conflict review without resolution
cases.expected_contract: Conflict review is offered, but copy never chooses a winner, merges values or forces overwrite.

cases.name: conflict keyboard mobile parity
cases.expected_contract: Single-focus mobile and keyboard/nonvisual paths preserve conflict meaning and the same upstream review action.

cases.name: offline bounded local state
cases.expected_contract: Only explicitly offline-capable local work may continue; service-backed mutation is not described as saved or accepted.

cases.name: offline creator draft remains nonauthoritative
cases.expected_contract: A local draft remains local until authoritative acceptance after reconnect; screen-reader copy states the same boundary.

cases.name: reconnect without success claim
cases.expected_contract: Transport restoration does not imply any unconfirmed mutation succeeded.

cases.name: reconnect reauthorizes cached projection
cases.expected_contract: After reconnect, role/permission/entitlement are re-evaluated before cached copy or actions reappear.

cases.name: ambiguous mutation status lookup
cases.expected_contract: Unknown outcome is not failure; status lookup is primary and blind mutation retry is absent.

cases.name: status unknown mobile screen reader
cases.expected_contract: Mobile/nonvisual delivery explicitly preserves unknown outcome and status lookup without relying on spinner, timing or color.

cases.name: accepted event projection lag
cases.expected_contract: Durable acceptance may be acknowledged while the displayed projection is separately identified as behind.

cases.name: projection lag transient not sole recovery carrier
cases.expected_contract: A transient acknowledgment may accompany, but not replace, persistent/nonvisual projection-lag status and refresh access.

cases.name: retryable read failure
cases.expected_contract: A nonmutating read retry is allowed without implying the resource exists beyond the already-authorized projection.

cases.name: retryable read assistant gm reauthorization
cases.expected_contract: Retry recomputes permission before returning data and Help receives only minimum safe context.

cases.name: idempotent retry after proof
cases.expected_contract: Operation identity and upstream idempotency/safe-retry proof exist; status is checked when ambiguity remains before retry.

cases.name: tracked retry never duplicates intent
cases.expected_contract: The same operation identity is reused according to upstream protocol so copy presentation cannot create duplicate mutation intent.

cases.name: visible approval pending
cases.expected_contract: A visible proposal may show pending state, but no decision, reason or future outcome is inferred.

cases.name: assistant gm pending scope
cases.expected_contract: Delegated approval visibility is rechecked before pending state is announced nonvisually.

cases.name: approval denial without reason
cases.expected_contract: Denial is visible but the reason is omitted because safe_reason is not authorized.

cases.name: approval denial authorized safe reason
cases.expected_contract: Only an already-authorized safe reason may interpolate; policy internals and hidden reviewer context remain excluded.

cases.name: help minimum safe context
cases.expected_contract: Help receives only F025-authorized minimum redacted state context and no hidden counts or raw diagnostics.

cases.name: redacted issue report consented
cases.expected_contract: Issue reporting is presented only through F025 authorization, consent, redaction, minimum fields and upstream operation identity.

cases.name: diagnostic preview redacts secrets
cases.expected_contract: Preview shows only allowlisted/redacted diagnostics and excludes secrets, raw logs, hidden payloads and policy internals.

cases.name: service actor diagnostics no scope bypass
cases.expected_contract: Service diagnostics remain narrow contract metadata and cannot expand the human user's visibility or support payload.

cases.name: disclosable entitlement restriction
cases.expected_contract: Entitlement wording is used only because the feature and entitlement fact are already disclosable.

cases.name: assistant gm entitlement nonvisual parity
cases.expected_contract: Nonvisual entitlement wording preserves the same disclosure ceiling and does not enumerate unavailable catalog items.

cases.name: authorized f024 source gap
cases.expected_contract: An authorized governance subject may see that behavior lacks authoritative F024 definition; no Pack lifecycle semantics are invented.

cases.name: protected source gap collapses unavailable
cases.expected_contract: When the gap fact itself is not authorized, source-gap handling collapses to safe-unavailable and does not prove Pack capability or absence.
